phases.name: plan
phases.description: T4 resident live: emit the implementation plan marker before the gated build

phases.name: build
phases.description: T4 resident live: gated build whose test command fails attempt 1 and passes attempt 2 (state-file counter under the leg's TMPDIR), so DF1.3 authorizes retry attempt 2 and the post_gate_failure solicitation point is reached with real gate evidence. maxDurationMs must exceed SOLICIT_TIMEOUT_MS (60s): pipeline-run.ts's code-phase gate loop shares ONE phase timer across command + gate + each solicitation (documented drift from DF1.3's per-attempt timer), so the in-phase post_gate_failure solicitation is charged here and a real model round-trip must not overflow the retry DF1.3 authorized
testCommand: f="$TMPDIR/qds-t4-resident-count"; n=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); n=$((n+1)); printf '%s' "$n" > "$f"; echo "t4 test attempt $n"; test "$n" -ge 2
